title: Hover a letter.
It switches.
slides.text: A live WebGL flower leans toward your cursor, and each letter of the headline spins like a slot reel before it lands.

title: Headlines that
form like liquid.
slides.text: Every display heading firms up from soft blobs into sharp letters as it scrolls into view.

title: Sections hand over
in dither.
slides.text: Between sections the next colour arrives as Bayer-dithered pixels. The cursor leaves the same dots behind it.

title: Real clients.
Real software.
slides.text: Jeeva Multispeciality Hospital: hospital management software and website, designed and built by One Prime Studio.

title: Your business,
switched on.
slides.text: Websites · Shopify stores · CRM & ERP · SaaS products · Brand identity. Hyderabad → Worldwide.
